Excalibur Prime: Founders Pack exclusive (Hunter tier or greater, program closed Nov 1 2013) - permanently unobtainable, not craftable, no duplicates obtainable
Lato Prime: Founders Pack exclusive (Grand Master tier, program closed Nov 1 2013) - permanently unobtainable, not craftable
Skana Prime: Founders Pack exclusive (Master or Grand Master tier, program closed Nov 1 2013) - permanently unobtainable, not craftable, untradeable
Orion & Sirius: Choice made during the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest (naming your character's son Orion or Sirius) - not farmable, tied to that quest playthrough
War Prime: Craft Hunhow's Trinket (bought from Hunhow in Pontis Tower after Jade Shadows: Constellations quest) using 12 Emerald Talent + 12 Crimson Talent from Uranus Proxima missions - account-bound, untradeable, only one copy obtainable
Coda Bubonico: Purchased from Eleanor (The Hex syndicate, Hollvania Central Mall) for 10 Live Heartcell from vanquishing a Technocyte Coda; rotates in Batch B offerings every 4 days
Opticor Vandal: Thermia Fractures event reward (100 cumulative points, one-time) OR Baro Ki'Teer (550,000 Credits + 650 Orokin Ducats, rotating stock)
Prisma Tetra: Baro Ki'Teer (Tenno Relay Concourse) for 50,000 Credits + 400 Orokin Ducats - rotating stock, not vaulted
Grimoire: Whispers in the Walls quest reward (max rank, free copy); additional copies via blueprint from Bird 3 of Cavia for 50,000 Standing (Rank 4 - Scholar required)
Prisma Twin Gremlins: Baro Ki'Teer (Tenno Relay Concourse) for 220,000 Credits + 500 Orokin Ducats - rotating stock
Prisma Dual Decurions: Baro Ki'Teer (Tenno Relay Concourse) for 175,000 Credits + 525 Orokin Ducats - rotating stock
Prisma Shade: Baro Ki'Teer (Tenno Relay Concourse) for 300,000 Credits + 500 Orokin Ducats - rotating stock; comes with Prisma Burst Laser
Deth Machine Rifle Prime: Automatically acquired with Dethcube Prime (Prime Vault companion) - not obtained separately
Prime Laser Rifle: Automatically acquired with Wyrm Prime (Prime Vault companion) - not obtained separately
Prisma Burst Laser: Automatically acquired when purchasing Prisma Shade from Baro Ki'Teer - not sold separately
Sweeper Prime: Automatically acquired with Carrier Prime - Carrier Prime entered the Prime Vault May 30 2017, so currently only via trading or a future unvaulting
Verglas: Automatically acquired with Nautilus (Sentinel) - not obtained separately, untradeable
Adarza Kavat: Kavat incubation (after Howl of the Kubrow quest + Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment) using 10 Kavat Genetic Codes scanned from Feral Kavats on Deimos - random result, or use Genetic Code Templates to improve odds
Crescent Vulpaphyla: Capture a weakened Crescent-subspecies Vulpaphyla via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, then Vulpaphyla Revivification at Son's Incubator (mutagen/antigen blueprints from Son, 5,000 Credits)
Sly Vulpaphyla: Capture a weakened Sly-subspecies Vulpaphyla via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, then Vulpaphyla Revivification at Son's Incubator (mutagen/antigen blueprints from Son, 5,000 Credits)
Helminth Charger: Kubrow Egg incubation, then infect a Warframe with a Helminth Cyst via Nidus/Nidus Prime and drain the matured (7-day) cyst to begin the charger's incubation, after Howl of the Kubrow quest
Huras Kubrow: Kubrow Egg incubation (after Howl of the Kubrow quest) - random result, or use Genetic Code Templates to improve odds of this breed
Sunika Kubrow: Kubrow Egg incubation (after Howl of the Kubrow quest) - random result, or use Genetic Code Templates to improve odds of this breed
Medjay Predasite: Capture a weakened Medjay-subspecies Predasite via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, then Predasite Revivification at Son's Incubator (mutagen/antigen blueprints from Son, 5,000 Credits)
Pharaoh Predasite: Capture a weakened Pharaoh-subspecies Predasite via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, then Predasite Revivification at Son's Incubator (mutagen/antigen blueprints from Son, 5,000 Credits)
Vizier Predasite: Capture a weakened Vizier-subspecies Predasite via Conservation in the Cambion Drift, then Predasite Revivification at Son's Incubator (mutagen/antigen blueprints from Son, 5,000 Credits)
